text:
young kings in cities complaining about women

over the weekend I conferred with my generation (age ~40)

we are gravely concerned about widespread emasculation, dating app addiction, and a Cambrian explosion of flaccid dork behavior

we feel somewhat responsible for this. it is on us to share with you the basic knowledge and wisdom that we received when we were your age

advice like "go approach a woman on the street in broad daylight and get her phone number," and "become fluent in rejection ASAP"

so, your failures are really our failures

we let you down somewhere along the line

when u are armed with basic survival skills, u aren't writing long-ass screeds online about how women have changed (they haven't)

u just go outside and walk around and talk to people, knowing that 99 no's will eventually be followed by a yes

too many mfs are uncontrollably seething on the couch after getting left on "Read" one time in an IG DM

suddenly everyone is Charles fuckin Darwin with these complex adaptive evolutionary theories, Instagram-driven hypergamous follower-count-chromosome-mutations

dog

it really isnt that serious lol

let me ask around and see what the elders and OGs have to say, I'm not Porfirio Rubirosa and I don't have all the answers, but I can compile everything that smooth cats send in my direction and then pass it along
